name: Misora Saku
source:
A longtime childhood friend of the protagonist since before they can even remember.

A very shy girl, she always covers her eyes with her bangs. Rarely does she express her own opinions, and oftentimes just go along with others. However, even if she doesn't express her thoughts in words, she is always ready to make any comebacks.

When she's with Youichi, she is able to talk normally, and with a face full of emotions at that.

"Even if it's just for a little, I want to make memories with you, You-kun..."

[Edited from [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/aibeya2/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
